Under each working condition, the vibration response of stairs and turbine floor is relatively large, which is the weak part of the powerhouse structure. Under all working conditions, the vibration responses of the typical structures of 5# unit section do not exceed the allowable vibration standards of building structures specified in various codes. However, under case 1 and 4, the root mean square vibration accelerations of several parts of 5<sup>#</sup> unit section are relatively large, which exceed the safety standard (1.0 m/s<sup>2</sup>), but will not cause structural damage (< 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>). Although the frequency weighting RMS acceleration does not exceed the limit, obvious vibration and noise may appear due to the high vibration frequency, which should be paid attention to.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-scale Urban Flood Model Based on Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering & Smart Water Conservancy and Intelligent Disaster Reduction Forum (ICHCE & SWIDR)
abstract: With the rapid development of climate change and urbanization, urban waterlogging has become increasingly serious. However, there are significant differences between short-term heavy rainfall and long-duration typhoon storms in urban waterlogging scenarios, which results in different requirements for prediction in the two scenarios. In order to study the risk of urban flood caused by these two types of rainfall, a multi-scale urban flood risk identification method based on multi-source data fusion is proposed. In the long-duration rainfall scenario, the satellite-measured elevation model and manual measurement data are fused to construct a two-dimensional model of the urban ground, and the two-dimensional hydrodynamic simulation describes the urban waterlogging. In the short-term heavy rainfall scenario, for the streets prone to waterlogging, based on the high-precision DEM model obtained by the drone, the urban drainage network model was constructed to simulate the waterlogging at the block scale. Fuzhou, a typical coastal city in China, was studied as a case, which proves that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Study on Vibration Interaction of the High Head Pumped Storage Power Plant with Different Speed Units
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering & Smart Water Conservancy and Intelligent Disaster Reduction Forum (ICHCE & SWIDR)
abstract: The underground powerhouse is equipped with two kinds of pump turbines with different speeds (the design speeds are 500r / min and 600r / min respectively), and the design water head is 710m. Both the design water head and the design speed of 600r / min are the highest in domestic pumped storage power stations. The vibration energy of high water head and high-speed unit is high, but there are few research data about the influence of two different speed units on the vibration of the plant structure. Based on the finite element dynamic time history method, the vibration responses of powerhouse structure equipped with two different speeds units under different working conditions are studied, under the assumption that each vibration load is harmonic load. The results show that the vibration of one unit will have a certain impact on the adjacent unit section, and the impact of the unit with high speed on the other unit is relatively large. When two units operate under the normal conditions, the vibration response of both unit sections increases compared with the normal operation of a single unit, the maximum value-added is not more than 4%, and the second dominant frequency of the vibration response curve is determined by the adjacent unit sections. When one unit works normally and the other unit runs under runaway condition, the vibration response of the unit section under normal working condition increases relatively. The results show that the vibration response indexes meet the requirements of the control standard under all working conditions. This study has reference value for vibration analysis and optimization design of large pumped storage power station with different speed units.

articleTitle: Research on the relationship between concrete linear expansion coefficient and gate pier’s endurance to cold shock
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering & Smart Water Conservancy and Intelligent Disaster Reduction Forum (ICHCE & SWIDR)
abstract: When the large-volume concrete structure of hydraulic engineering encounters a sudden drop in ambient temperature, the instantaneous temperature stress can easily cause the surface of the large-volume concrete to crack. Taking concrete pier as an example, ANSYS software is used in this paper to simulate the influence process of rainstorm or flood release, and sudden temperature drop on the surface tensile stress of the structure. At the same time, the variation range of tensile stress on pier surface produced by different linear expansion coefficients, temperature drops, and pier thickness is calculated. It is found that in the case of a sudden drop in ambient temperature, the thickness of the gate pier has little effect on the change of surface tensile stress, while the linear expansion coefficient has a great effect. Furthermore, the ability of concrete piers with different linear expansion coefficients to withstand heavy rain, flood discharge, and sudden temperature drop is obtained. The results can provide a certain reference for the selection of pier concrete raw materials under different climates and different reservoir water temperature conditions.

articleTitle: Bridge tower modeling based on 3D experience platform
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering & Smart Water Conservancy and Intelligent Disaster Reduction Forum (ICHCE & SWIDR)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of my country’s bridge construction technology and the continuous improvement of design and calculation theories, the modeling of bridges has also become more complicated. Traditional design, modeling methods have become unable to meet the demand. The continuous improvement of computer performance and the advent of new design software provide solutions to such problems. The 3D experience platform under the French Dassault Company has powerful curve modeling and rapid modeling capabilities, and is suitable for modeling new structures. Based on the 3D experience platform and relying on the Prince City project, this paper uses the “skeleton + template” modeling method to complete the three-dimensional modeling work of the special-shaped pylons of the Fifth Ring Bridge, which solves the problems of similar structure modeling difficulties and long modeling time. At the same time, it provides ideas for modeling similar structures.

articleTitle: Distribution and effectiveness of soil and water conservation monitoring about Water Conservancy Project
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering & Smart Water Conservancy and Intelligent Disaster Reduction Forum (ICHCE & SWIDR)
abstract: Xinjiang Kurgan Water Conservancy Project Construction Administration in order to implement the water and soil conservation plan, strengthen the design and construction management of water and soil conservation, optimize the prevention and control measures of water and soil loss, and coordinate the progress of the water and soil conservation project and the construction of the main project; timely and accurately grasp the project soil erosion status and prevention effect, put forward soil and water conservation improvement measures, reduce man-made soil and water loss; to find out major soil erosion hazards in time and put forward countermeasures and suggestions on soil erosion prevention and control; to provide the technical basis of water and soil conservation supervision and management and the basic information of public supervision, to promote the effective protection and timely recovery of the ecological environment in the project area, Yellow River Institute of Hydraulic Research was specially entrusted to carry out the water and soil conservation monitoring work of the project.

articleTitle: 2D Numerical Simulation Study on Influence of Bridge Superposition on Water Flow Regime
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering & Smart Water Conservancy and Intelligent Disaster Reduction Forum (ICHCE & SWIDR)
abstract: With more and more intensive bridge construction, the superposition of the water blocking and turbulence influence of river piers has increased the complexity of river flow. A numerical simulation and an analysis are conducted on the influence of the superposition of the proposed Xin’an River Grand Bridge and Yanjiang Bridge in a flood control reservoir area on the flow regime based on two-dimensional shallow water equations. When the flood peak passes, the backwater effect of Yanjiang Bridge and the proposed Xin’an River Grand Bridge will be superposed, leading to an increase in the backwater height and scope of the proposed bridge upstream. At the same time, the proposed bridge will make an impact on the backwater from the completed Yanjiang Bridge downstream. When the flood peak passes, the proposed bridge will make a significant impact on the flow velocity near the piers of Yanjiang Bridge downstream, while Yanjiang Bridge will have less influence on the flow velocity around the proposed bridge.

articleTitle: Direct shear test of RCC interlayer in Muruo Hydropower Station Project
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering & Smart Water Conservancy and Intelligent Disaster Reduction Forum (ICHCE & SWIDR)
abstract: With the continuous development of RCC construction technology, RCC dam is more and more widely used in dam construction. The shear strength between the contact surfaces of different layers of RCC is an important basis for studying whether the dam pouring is qualified or not. Based on this, through the direct shear test of different layers of RCC dam, in-situ direct shear test of 7 groups of 28 specimens between different layers is carried out to determine the mechanical parameters of concrete between different layers. According to the field test results, some reference suggestions for the field direct shear test and the selection of direct shear strength in the engineering design are put forward, and the reliability of the RCC construction quality is verified.

articleTitle: Investigation and verification of the relationship between the average temperature of the circular section of the cooling water pipe and the maximum temperature of the section in the mass concrete
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering & Smart Water Conservancy and Intelligent Disaster Reduction Forum (ICHCE & SWIDR)
abstract: In the construction of mass concrete structures, temperature control measures such as laying cooling water pipes are often applied. The equivalent cooling algorithm used in the simulation calculation has no obvious spatial gradient in the simulated temperature field. The maximum temperature control index cannot be directly used for pouring blocks for water pipe cooling. Therefore, this article mainly explores and verifies the quantitative relationship between the average temperature of the circular section of the cooling water pipe in the mass concrete and the maximum temperature of the section. According to some existing bottom plate data, the average temperature of the circular cross-section of the cooling water pipe is obtained by numerical integration. The highest temperature of the cross-section is divided by the average temperature, and the deviation coefficient is between 1.08-1.16, with an average of 1.12. In the construction of a flow passage structure, the measured average temperature considering the deviation coefficient is mostly lower than the temperature control index of flow passage, and there is not much difference between the two, which to some extent compensates for the uniform temperature field gradient of the equivalent cooling algorithm. Engineering practice has proved that the deviation coefficient has certain application values for the temperature control and crack prevention of mass concrete structures.

articleTitle: Shear lag effect formula of corrugated steel webs based on spring model
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering & Smart Water Conservancy and Intelligent Disaster Reduction Forum (ICHCE & SWIDR)
abstract: The stress characteristics of composite box girder with corrugated steel webs are quite different from those of ordinary concrete box girder. In order to study the normal stress distribution law of the upper and lower flange plates of the corrugated steel web shear lag effect, the corrugated steel web flange plate is reasonably equivalent to the longitudinal parallel parallel spring model. The minimum potential energy principle is used to understand the warping displacement function form of the corrugated steel web, and the normal stress distribution of the wing plate is obtained. Finally, the calculation formula for the normal stress distribution of the corrugated steel web flange plate is obtained. By comparing the calculated values and the measured values with the finite element values, it is found that the formula has good applicability to solve the normal stress distribution of corrugated steel web box girder under shear lag effect.

articleTitle: Selection and Experimental Study on Foundation Bearing Stratum of a Coal—Fired Power Plant in Eastern Inner Mongolia, China
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering & Smart Water Conservancy and Intelligent Disaster Reduction Forum (ICHCE & SWIDR)
abstract: In this paper, the selection of bearing stratum of foundation is studied in a coal-fired thermal power plant in eastern inner mongolia, China. A large number of test data are obtained by means of drilling, exploratory well, standard penetration test (SPT), laboratory test and shallow plate load test in immersed water loess. The engineering characteristics of ②loess-like silty clay in the site are comprehensively determined, and the experience of local construction engineering is broken through. In the deep bedrock area, it is recommended that the loess stratum can be used as bearing stratum of foundation in the main buildings in the power plant. The research results of this paper give full play to the potential of bearing capacity of ②loess-like silty clay, optimize the foundation form of the building. So pile foundation can not be designed in the deep bedrock area, and ultimately shorten the construction period and reduce the cost of the project.

Author Keywords: shallow plate load test in immersed water loess

articleTitle: Inverse calculation of stress-free line type of transmission conductor based on designed line type
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering & Smart Water Conservancy and Intelligent Disaster Reduction Forum (ICHCE & SWIDR)
abstract: This paper is based on the finite element method and adopts the new idea of superposition of vertical displacement forward and backward to simplify the problem of transmission line type finding in engineering application. Based on an engineering example, this paper uses the finite element software Midas Civil to calculate the vertical displacement of different sagging conductors under the load of its own weight. It is concluded that the smaller the sagging of the same transmission line under the load of its own weight, the smaller the vertical displacement of the transmission line. That is, the vertical displacement generated under the action of its own weight is reversely superimposed back to the design line type. The line type obtained cannot return to the design line type under the action of gravity. Based on the above conclusions, the vertical displacement under the design line type can be superimposed back into the design line type, and the primary line type of the conductor under the design sag can be derived from this, and then the vertical displacement of the primary line type under its own weight can be positive Superimpose to the primary linear pattern and subtract it from the design linear pattern to get the difference, then add the difference positively to the sum of the primary linear pattern and the vertical displacement to get the secondary linear pattern, and so on to get the third and fourth times Line style. With the increase of the number of positive and negative iterations, the difference between the coordinates of the n-th line type under its own weight and the design line type coordinates will infinitely approach zero. According to the actual accuracy requirements of the project, Matlab is used to write a program for repeated positive and negative accumulation. By controlling the number of positive and negative accumulations, the line type infinitely converges to the design line type under the action of gravity, there by obtaining the wire stress-free line type.
